name: com.alexmah.dotasset
description: Headless asset operations for scripts and AI agents: export prefabs, scenes, ScriptableObjects, materials, Animator Controllers and importer settings to JSON, create assets from a JSON spec, edit them in place with all-or-nothing writes, migrate references after a move or script change, and audit missing references, textures and materials. Runs inside the open editor through a file queue, or headless through -batchmode, with the same output either way.
